description: F03 Terminal aggregate kernel. Rust terminal-core owns viewport dimension/history capacity, user-resize clamping and the portable scroll/circling notification policy that native shells forward to scrollbar and renderer boundaries.

entries.notes: TerminalLayout clamps rows/columns to 1..SHRT_MAX using the same negative, zero and oversized vectors as Microsoft.
TerminalLayout clamps configured history to zero or remaining SHRT_MAX capacity and exposes the resulting total row count.
User resize clamps backing rows at SHRT_MAX while preserving configured history, so shrinking the viewport restores the original total exactly as the Microsoft regression requires.

TerminalLayout owns the portable scroll policy for both Microsoft data rows: viewport/history progression, optional scrollbar notification while the backing buffer circles, and renderer TriggerScroll delta (0,-1). Native renderer/callback delivery remains a boundary consumer of this semantic update.
